lines.speaker: A
lines.pinyin: Duìbuqǐ, wǒ zhǎo bu dào lù le.
lines.en: Sorry, I can't find my way.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Where do you want to go?

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: I want to go to the train station.

lines.speaker: B
lines.zh: 火车站不在这儿，你走错方向了。
lines.pinyin: Huǒchēzhàn bú zài zhèr, nǐ zǒu cuò fāngxiàng le.
lines.en: The station isn't here, you're going the wrong way.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Then how do I get there?

lines.speaker: B
lines.zh: 一直往前走，然后在左边坐地铁。
lines.pinyin: Yìzhí wǎng qián zǒu, ránhòu zài zuǒbiān zuò dìtiě.
lines.en: Go straight ahead, then take the metro on the left.

lines.speaker: B
lines.zh: 不远，走路十五分钟就到。
lines.pinyin: Bù yuǎn, zǒulù shíwǔ fēnzhōng jiù dào.
lines.en: Not far, fifteen minutes on foot.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: You are welcome, take care on the way.
